feature: AI Mesh Firewall gateway end-to-end hardening (SDK compat + leak elimination + UI)

userStories.title: OpenAI SDK conformance harness (the gate for all SDK stories)
userStories.userStory: As a maintainer I need an executable conformance suite so SDK-compat stories have a real gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_openai_sdk_compat.py: REAL app over httpx.ASGITransport driven by the stock `openai` SDK; ONLY the upstream provider stubbed.

Cells: chat non-stream+stream+tool_calls+json_schema+usage; responses non-stream+typed-stream+previous_response_id+retrieve/delete; embeddings; models list; errors assert exception CLASS AND that e.code/e.type/e.param/e.message are populated and e.request_id non-empty.
Pin `openai` to an exact version in gateway test deps; record it in progress.txt.
Gate green: cd gateway && python -m pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_openai_sdk_compat.py -q (cells that need later fixes are marked xfail with the defect id).

userStories.title: Recording-provider egress-capture rig + PII corpus (the gate for all leak stories)
userStories.userStory: As a maintainer I need to capture exactly what the provider receives so leaks are provable.
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/leakhunt/recording_provider.py (fake OpenAI/embedding/vector upstream recording exact request bytes) + assert_no_pii_egressed(corpus).
Create tests/leakhunt/corpus.py covering PII classes and formats incl. bare-10-digit, 5+5 spaced, +CC-10-digit phones.
Add test_repro_g0.py reproducing the known leak (redact verdict, raw phone in egress) — RED is acceptable here; it documents the gap the B-stories fix.
Gate green: cd gateway && python -m pytest tests/leakhunt -q runs (repro tests may be xfail until fixed).

userStories.title: Verdict-scrub honesty invariant on the input/egress path (G0b/G4)
userStories.userStory: As a user I must never have raw PII forwarded while the verdict says redact.
acceptanceCriteria: When any tier sets action in {redact,mask} OR a caller attests assume_redacted=True, verify the flagged span is actually gone from the outbound bytes; if the scrubber is a no-op, fail closed (stronger scrub or block).
Mirror the output-guard noop-honesty check (main.py:1330) onto the input/egress path; never report redact while forwarding raw.
Gate green: a new tests/leakhunt test proves no phantom redaction across chat + responses; tests/leakhunt -q green.

userStories.title: Phone/intl redactor coverage for leaking formats, context-gated (G0)
userStories.userStory: As a user my phone number is redacted regardless of format, without over-redacting order ids.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend patterns.py phone handling to catch bare-10-digit, 5+5, +CC formats using context-gating (phone cue or Tier-2 verdict) so order-id/revenue numbers still pass.
Gate green: corpus phone formats neutralized in egress; a false-positive test proves revenue/order-id strings are untouched; tests/leakhunt -q green.

userStories.title: Scan + redact /v1/embeddings input (G1)
userStories.userStory: As a user, embedding inputs are scanned so raw PII never reaches the embedding provider.
acceptanceCriteria: Add input scan+redaction to the /v1/embeddings handler at parity with chat; fail-safe on no-op scrub.
Gate green: client.embeddings.create(input=<PII>) yields PII-free captured egress; SDK harness embeddings cell green; tests/leakhunt -q green.

userStories.title: Unify embedding + simulator/SDK egress redaction (G3/G0c)
userStories.userStory: As a user, every path applies identical redaction so no path leaks while another redacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Make /v1/embeddings and the RAG-ingest byok_embedder path share one redaction implementation; make the simulator (bedrock_inference) and SDK (acompletion->_apply_redaction) egress outcomes identical.
Gate green: a differential test asserts byte-identical redaction across paths for the corpus; tests/leakhunt -q green.

userStories.title: RAG redaction default + nothing raw at rest in the vector store (G2)
userStories.userStory: As a user, ingested PII is never stored raw at rest in the vector DB (content or metadata).
acceptanceCriteria: Flip rag_redaction_enabled to safe-by-default (or force-on by policy for regulated orgs); guarantee nothing raw is embedded/stored.
Point a test org's ingest at chromadb (localhost:8001); after ingest, QUERY the store directly and assert no raw corpus fixture in documents OR metadata; include a poisoned-doc case.
Gate green: tests/leakhunt at-rest test green against chromadb.

userStories.title: Unify error envelope + x-request-id via one /v1 shim (D2/D3)
userStories.userStory: As an SDK user, errors carry e.code/e.type/e.param and every response has a request id.
acceptanceCriteria: Add one choke point (exception handler/middleware on /v1/*) that rewrites flat {error,message,code} bodies via responses_adapters.coerce_chat_error_to_openai and guarantees x-request-id on every response.
Gate green: SDK harness error-field cells + request_id cell go from xfail to pass; full pytest green.

userStories.title: Delete dead duplicate /v1/responses handler (D1)
userStories.userStory: As a maintainer, only one /v1/responses route exists to avoid confusion.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the shadowed second @app.post('/v1/responses') (main.py ~7988); keep the full-featured handler (streaming+store).
Gate green: a route-introspection test asserts exactly one POST /v1/responses route; responses harness cells stay green.

userStories.title: Responses typed-stream event conformance (D5)
userStories.userStory: As an SDK user, responses.create(stream=True) yields correct typed events.
acceptanceCriteria: _translate_chat_stream_to_responses emits response.created -> output_item.added -> content_part.added -> output_text.delta... -> output_text.done -> output_item.done -> response.completed (response.failed on guard block), framed event:/data:.
Gate green: the SDK harness responses-stream cell asserts yielded event.type sequence and passes.

userStories.title: Add models/{id}, completions, moderations; 404 images/audio (D4)
userStories.userStory: As an SDK user, common endpoints resolve and unsupported ones 404 cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /v1/models/{model}; POST /v1/completions (prompt->messages through the SAME firewall, return text_completion); POST /v1/moderations (wire existing detectors to the OpenAI moderation schema); 404+nested-envelope for /v1/images and /v1/audio.
Gate green: SDK harness cells for these endpoints pass; full pytest green.

userStories.title: Verify auth flows + GatewayKeyPanel in browser
userStories.userStory: As a user, login/logout/session and API-key create/rotate/copy/revoke work and never expose the secret.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: login (valid/invalid/empty), OAuth callback, logout, inactivity modal; GatewayKeyPanel create/rotate/copy/revoke shows only a 'Key Set' badge.
Gate green: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build; browser flow verified with screenshots; no console errors.

userStories.title: Verify model/routing/kill-switch panels in browser (1.5/1.6)
userStories.userStory: As a user, I can connect/route models and disable/isolate/reroute, and the UI reflects state.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: ModelConnection/Governance, RoutingGovernance/Audit, KillSwitch/ModelState — click every control, assert state badges and results.
Gate green: lint+build; browser-verified with screenshots; no console errors.

userStories.title: Verify RAG/Vector + DatabaseConnection panels in browser (1.2/1.3)
userStories.userStory: As a user, I can connect a vector store, manage collections/namespaces, and run RAG feature tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: DatabaseConnection status, VectorPolicy, collection manager, RAGFeatureTest/AttackTrust/PipelineTelemetry.
Gate green: lint+build; browser-verified with screenshots; no console errors.

userStories.title: Verify MCP panels in browser (1.4)
userStories.userStory: As a user, I can manage MCP connectors and run scans, with results shown correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: MCPConnector/Manager/Scanner/ScanControlMatrix — click every control, assert results.
Gate green: lint+build; browser-verified with screenshots; no console errors.

userStories.title: Verify output-guardrail panels + LogViewer in browser (1.7), incl. UI honesty
userStories.userStory: As a user, output-guardrail controls work and the Log viewer never renders raw secrets it shouldn't.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: OutputGovernance/Controls/Charts/Engine/Timeline; LogViewer/LogDetail filters + drill-down; assert no raw secret/PII is displayed where it shouldn't be, and dashboard counts match enforced reality.
Gate green: lint+build; browser-verified with screenshots; no console errors.

userStories.title: Verify how-to + live simulators run end-to-end in browser (demo app)
userStories.userStory: As a new customer, the how-to is correct and every simulator runs to a clear, honest result.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: HowToUse (snippets copyable+correct, instructions match real UI); AttackSimulator, RAGAttackTrust, IsolationOps, BedrockTest run e2e and show correct allow/block/redact verdicts; honest result display (claimed redaction reflected on screen).
Gate green: lint+build; each simulator verified e2e with screenshots; no console errors.
